The old imports from com.google.api.services.cloudresourcemanager.model no longer exist. In v3, Project and Policy are available under com.google.api.services.cloudresourcemanager.v3.model, but OrgPolicy and Constraint were removed from Cloud Resource Manager (moved to a separate Org Policy API). Since we must not change method signatures and only adjust client code, we will:

1) Update imports to point to v3 model for Project and Policy.
2) Provide minimal placeholder nested types for OrgPolicy and Constraint inside the interface to preserve existing method signatures without relying on removed classes.

This keeps the interface compilable with the new dependency while maintaining the same API surface in our client code.
